visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved top and a white baseball cap, walks away from the camera at an airport terminal. A hand reaches into the frame from the left, prompting her to turn around. She stops and smiles at the camera holder. (2) She stands in front of airport check-in counters and baggage carts, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. (3) A close-up view of the woman's face as she points upward with both index fingers while smiling. (4) Close-up shot of a white and blue plastic jar of skincare cream being held in a hand. The label features blue text and the brand logo. (5) The woman is indoors in a well-lit room, wearing a bear-ear headband. She applies the cream to her cheek using her fingers, demonstrating its texture. (6) A split-screen comparison shows a close-up of skin on her cheek, labeled 'Before' and 'After', showing a reduction in redness and smoother texture. (7) She presses a white tissue against her cheek and removes it to show no residue. Then, she uses a makeup sponge to apply foundation over the cream-treated skin. (8) A hand holds the product jar against an airplane window, with white clouds and a blue sky visible outside. (9) In a bathroom setting, she wears a white bathrobe and head towel, applying the cream to her face in front of a mirror. (10) A rapid montage of split-screen images shows plates of seafood, colorful cocktails, and the woman in different travel outfits in various city locations. (11) Back to the indoor setting, she holds the product jar next to her face, smiling and pointing at it before waving to the camera.

(3) The female narrator shifts to a descriptive, professional tone explaining the product's benefits. (4) Distinct pop SFX and dings emphasize specific product application points and the 'Before/After' reveal. (5) The upbeat music maintains a steady 125 BPM throughout. (6) Audio concludes with a final summary sentence from the female speaker and a bright synthesizer sting SFX.
